definitions.explanation: The highest or most intense degree of something. Used to express that something has reached its absolute limit or pinnacle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{感動|かんどう}→感動：00167_kandou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{極|きわ}みだ。
examples.english: It is the height of emotion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失礼|しつれい}→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{極|きわ}み⟦と→と：00512_to⟧しか⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧よう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: It can only be described as the height of rudeness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧、⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{極|きわ}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}した→達する：02129_tassuru⟧⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧だ。
examples.english: This is the work of a craftsman who reached the pinnacle of skill after years of effort.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always appears in the pattern 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{極|きわ}み (the height/extreme of ~). Common combinations include ⟦{感動|かんどう}→感動：00167_kandou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{極|きわ}み (the height of emotion), ⟦{失礼|しつれい}→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{極|きわ}み (the height of rudeness), and ⟦{贅沢|ぜいたく}→贅沢：03309_zeitaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{極|きわ}み (the height of luxury). The expression ⟦{恐縮|きょうしゅく}→恐縮：07596_kyoushuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{極|きわ}み is a very formal, humble way to express deep gratitude or apology.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{感動|かんどう}→感動：00167_kandou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{極|きわ}み: the height of emotion
- ⟦{失礼|しつれい}→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{極|きわ}み: the height of rudeness
- ⟦{贅沢|ぜいたく}→贅沢：03309_zeitaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{極|きわ}み: the ultimate luxury
- ⟦{恐縮|きょうしゅく}→恐縮：07596_kyoushuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{極|きわ}み: most humbly grateful (very formal)
